name: Revive
description:
<rt.absorb>Revive</> target dead ally.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used in combat</>

name: (CUT) Elemental Empowerment
description:
+20 Bonus Main Stat. This is increased by 2.75 for every 15 item levels your item has.

Main stats are Strength, Agility and Intellect.

name: Interject Spell
description:
<rt.absorb>Interrupt</> the target's spellcasting and prevent it from casting for 4 sec. 
Must interrupt a spell, or it will have no effect.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Restore Mana
description:
Instantly restore <rt.mana>30% of your maximum mana</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Major Dispel
description:
Instantly <rt.heal>Dispel all harmful magic effects</> from you and your allies in a large radius around you.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Sanctuary
description:
Grants <rt.heal>15% Damage Reduction</> to yourself and nearby allies for 15 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Major Invisibility
description:
Instantly conceal yourself all nearby allies, granting <rt.effect>Major Invisiblilty</> for 15 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can only be used out of combat.</>

name: Bloodrite Fervor
description:
You and nearby allies gain <rt.absorb>50% increased Movement Speed</> for 12 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Obsidian Skin
description:
Grants <rt.heal>30% Damage Reduction</> to yourself for 9 seconds.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Chickenize!
description:
Instantly turn your target into a chicken.

<rt.absorb>Chickenize!</> can only be used a limited amount of times per dungeon. The charges are shared by everyone in the party.

<rt.effect>Chickenized</> enemies <rt.warning>do not give Kill Score.</>

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>

name: Conjure Portal
description:
Conjures two interactable <rt.absorb>Portals</> that you and your allies can use to safely travel between two points.

<rt.meikoability2>Can only have 1 active portal at a time.</>

name: Rejuvenate
description:
Instantly replenish <rt.heal>40% of your maximum health</>.

<rt.meikoability2>Can be used during Global Cooldown</>
